name: Ookami to Koushinryou - Umi o Wataru Kaze
original_name: 狼と香辛料 海を渡る風
source:
Get ready to step into the shoes of Kraft Lawrence as you strive to take Holo back to her hometown of Yoitsu. 

Having secured a contract to collect some money from a town on the other shore, everything should be plain sailing ahead for the duo, but of course, the best laid plans of mice and wolves often go awry…

[From [url=https://agtteam.tumblr.com/post/685785217862090752/spice-and-wolf-the-wind-that-spans-the]AGT Team[/url]]
translation:
准备扮演克拉福·罗伦斯，努力把赫萝送回故乡约伊兹。

两人已签下一份合约，要从对岸城镇收回一笔钱，按理说接下来的旅程应该一帆风顺；然而，人与狼最周密的计划往往也会出错…

[摘自[url=https://agtteam.tumblr.com/post/685785217862090752/spice-and-wolf-the-wind-that-spans-the]AGT Team[/url]]
